name: PlotArea
description: Represents the plot area of a chart.
remarks: This is the area where your chart data is plotted. The plot area on a 2D chart contains the data markers, gridlines, data labels, trendlines, and optional chart items placed in the chart area. The plot area on a 3D chart contains all the above items plus the walls, floor, axes, axis titles, and tick-mark labels in the chart. The plot area is surrounded by the chart area. The chart area on a 2D chart contains the axes, the chart title, the axis titles, and the legend. The chart area on a 3D chart contains the chart title and the legend. For information about formatting the chart area, see the ChartArea object.
example:
Charts("Chart1").Activate
With ActiveChart
 .ChartArea.Border.LineStyle = xlDash
 .PlotArea.Border.LineStyle = xlDot
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the name of the object.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the height, in points, of the object.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the distance, in points, from the left edge of the object to the left edge of column A (on a worksheet) or the left edge of the chart area (on a chart).

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the distance, in points, from the top edge of the object to the top of row 1 (on a worksheet) or the top of the chart area (on a chart).

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the width, in points, of the object.

properties.name: InsideLeft
properties.description: Returns the distance from the chart edge to the inside left edge of the plot area, in points. Read/write Double.

properties.name: InsideTop
properties.description: Returns the distance from the chart edge to the inside top edge of the plot area, in points. Read/write Double.

properties.name: InsideWidth
properties.description: Returns the inside width of the plot area, in points. Read/write Double.

properties.name: InsideHeight
properties.description: Returns the inside height of the plot area, in points. Read/write Double.

properties.name: Position
properties.description: Returns or sets the position of the plot area on the chart. Read/write XlChartElementPosition.

methods.name: ClearFormats
methods.description: Clears the formatting of the object.
